name: SecRouter
description: Self-hosted secure AI gateway — OIDC-authenticated, policy-governed, cost-tracked, audited. OpenAI-compatible; routes to the cheapest capable model across AWS Bedrock GovCloud, Azure OpenAI, and self-hosted providers.

baseUrl.description: URL of your self-hosted SecRouter gateway (e.g. https://secrouter.internal.example.mil).

token.description: OIDC bearer token (JWT) from your IdP, forwarded to the gateway for authentication.
